description:
The second season of Shaonian Ge Xing Don't be afraid of failure. Don't waste your youth. After Xiao Se and Lei Wujie came to Snow and Moon City, Sikong Changfeng forcibly took Xiao Se as his apprentice. Lei Wujie and Li Hanyi recognized each other. As Xiao Se entered Snow and Moon City, other princes of Tianqi were eager to seek allies. A battle between princes slowly started at the hero banquet in Lei Jia Bao.

(Source: Bilibili TV)
